claims.text: BDZs are the standard of care to control rigidity and spasms.
claims.quote: Benzodiazepines are the standard of care to control rigidity and spasms.
claims.locator: Treatment of Tetanus › Management of muscle spasms

claims.text: Midazolam is water soluble and preferred for prolonged therapy.
claims.quote: Diazepam has been used most extensively, but midazolam is water soluble and preferred for prolonged therapy.
claims.locator: Treatment of Tetanus › Management of muscle spasms

claims.text: BDZs may not prevent reflex spasms: NM blockade (vecuronium or other paralytics) + mechanical ventilation may be needed.
claims.quote: Benzodiazepines may not prevent reflex spasms, and effective respiration may require neuromuscular blockade with vecuronium or other paralytic medications and mechanical ventilation.
claims.locator: Treatment of Tetanus › Management of muscle spasms

claims.text: HTN/tachycardia episodes: beta-blockade, but long-acting drugs such as propranolol aren't recommended (sudden cardiac death is a complication of tetanus, and beta-blockade can increase risk).
claims.quote: Beta-blockade is used to control episodes of hypertension and tachycardia, but use of long-acting medications such as propranolol is not recommended. Sudden cardiac death is a complication of tetanus, and beta-blockade can increase risk.
claims.locator: Treatment of Tetanus › Management of autonomic dysfunction

claims.text: Esmolol, a short-acting beta-blocker, has been used successfully.
claims.quote: Esmolol, a short-acting beta-blocker, has been used successfully.
claims.locator: Treatment of Tetanus › Management of autonomic dysfunction

claims.text: High-dose IV atropine markedly reduces excessive sweating and secretions and manages bradycardia.
claims.quote: Blockade of the parasympathetic nervous system with high-dose IV atropine markedly reduces excessive sweating and secretions and manages bradycardia.
claims.locator: Treatment of Tetanus › Management of autonomic dysfunction

claims.text: Clonidine use has been associated w decreased mortality.
claims.quote: Use of clonidine, an alpha adrenergic receptor agonist, has been associated with decreased mortality (3).
claims.locator: Treatment of Tetanus › Management of autonomic dysfunction

claims.text: Mg sulfate continuous IV infusion (serum levels 4 to 8 mEq/L) has a stabilizing effect; use the patellar reflex to assess overdose.
claims.quote: Magnesium sulfate given by IV continuous infusion at doses that maintain serum levels between 4 to 8 mEq/L has a stabilizing effect, eliminating catecholamine stimulation (4). Patellar tendon reflex is used to assess overdosage.
claims.locator: Treatment of Tetanus › Management of autonomic dysfunction

claims.quote: Glucocorticoids are of unproven benefit; their use is not recommended.
